headline.en: Inspect the text overhead of tool envelopes.
headline.zh: 检查工具封装带来的文本开销。

sub.en: envelcost serializes configured tool-envelope templates, counts their text, and records profiles that can feed a capacity scenario.
sub.zh: envelcost 序列化配置的工具封装模板、计算文本 token，并记录可供容量情景使用的 profile。

body.en: You can inspect the exact serialization.
body.zh: 可以检查确切序列化内容。

body.en: Use the same tokenizer when comparing representations.
body.zh: 比较不同表示时可使用同一 tokenizer。

body.en: Capacity output remains a scenario over supplied ratios.
body.zh: 容量输出仍是基于给定比值的情景。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Serialize one complete read tool in compact and JSON-schema forms and count both with the same available cl100k tokenizer.
note.zh: 将一个完整 read 工具序列化为紧凑和 JSON-schema 形式，并使用同一个可用 cl100k tokenizer 统计。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Serialize one explicit tool definition in two project representations and count both with the same available cl100k tokenizer. No real harness capture, model execution, GPU capacity or preserved tool-schema equivalence.

body.en: Serialize one complete read tool in compact and JSON-schema forms and count both with the same available cl100k tokenizer.
body.zh: 将一个完整 read 工具序列化为紧凑和 JSON-schema 形式，并使用同一个可用 cl100k tokenizer 统计。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/envelcost.git
cd envelcost
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The envelope templates are project models, not captures proving the behavior of named current harnesses.
limitations.zh: 封装模板是项目建模，不是证明当前同名调用框架行为的抓包记录。

limitations.en: The compact form omits recursive schema details retained by JSON. Smaller text does not establish equivalent tool-calling behavior.
limitations.zh: 紧凑形式省略 JSON 保留的递归 schema 细节；文本更小不证明工具调用行为等价。

limitations.en: Token ratios alone do not measure throughput or GPU seat capacity. Capacity and cost outputs depend on assumed coefficients and registry data.
limitations.zh: token 比值不能单独测量吞吐或 GPU 座位容量；容量和费用输出依赖假设系数与登记数据。

body.en: A verbose tool schema adds input text before the task itself. Comparing the actual serialized representations exposes what was counted and which schema information each representation retains.
body.zh: 冗长工具 schema 会在任务本身之前增加输入文本。比较实际序列化表示，可以看清统计了什么，以及各表示保留了哪些 schema 信息。

body.en: ToolDef supplies compact and JSON-schema serializations. EnvelopeConfig combines them with task and turn wrappers. Tokenizer counts the selected representation; Runner stores EnvelopeProfile records, and Projector applies configured capacity assumptions to their ratios.
body.zh: ToolDef 提供紧凑与 JSON-schema 序列化。EnvelopeConfig 与任务、轮次包装组合，Tokenizer 计算 token，Runner 保存 EnvelopeProfile，Projector 按配置容量假设使用这些比值。

body.en: ToolDef supplies compact and JSON-schema serializations. EnvelopeConfig combines them with task and turn wrappers. Tokenizer counts the selected representation; Runner stores EnvelopeProfile records, and Projector applies configured capacity assumptions to their ratios.
body.zh: ToolDef 提供紧凑与 JSON-schema 序列化。EnvelopeConfig 与任务、轮次包装组合，Tokenizer 计算 token，Runner 保存 EnvelopeProfile，Projector 按配置容量假设使用这些比值。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: run accepts a configured harness list and task selection; its default path is offline template tokenization. Optional online mode makes real requests. Tokenizer fallback can use character-based estimates, so retain which tokenizer was available when comparing profiles.
body.zh: run 接收配置封装列表和任务选择，默认是离线模板分词；可选在线模式会实际请求。Tokenizer 回退可能使用字符估算，因此比较 profile 时应保留实际可用 tokenizer 信息。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
envelcost run
envelcost report
# Scenario projection, not a load test:
envelcost project --gpus 8xH100 --seats 50
